Oliver —

Thanks for sending the W-9 and bank letter. A few quick items to keep this moving:

- Our PO system requires the supplier legal name to match the W-9/EIN. If you want the PO to show the DBA on the document, we can add a "Doing business as" field in the PO, but the vendor record needs the legal name to match Treasury/IRS records.
- We need confirmation of signer authority. For corporate signers we accept either: (1) a copy of the corporate resolution or (2) a notarized signature page.
- If a notarized route is preferred, the video-notary option you mentioned is fine; please share the video-notary attestation or DocuSign envelope.

I've attached our procurement onboarding checklist to outline the minimal set (W-9, bank letter, signer proof). Copying Laura in Finance to confirm whether they require a bank-letter notarization or if a stamped letter is sufficient. Monica from Vendor Ops is on the thread to start the vendor record once we have the signer proof.

If you can get back today with either the corporate resolution or a notarized signature, we should be able to create a provisional PO (REQ-8921) and put the vendor into "pending finance verification" status.

Thanks,
